Contact.Note: * FormerPI: Named Gravity Science team lead on the launch-era SwRI Juno spacecraft page (https://www.missionjuno.swri.edu/spacecraft/juno-spacecraft); later leads were William Folkner, then Ryan Park and Luciano Iess * Author: Named Gravity Science team lead on the launch-era SwRI Juno spacecraft page (https://www.missionjuno.swri.edu/spacecraft/juno-spacecraft)

* FormerPI: Listed as Gravity Science Principal Investigator in the NSSDC Master Catalog (https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/nmc/experiment/display.action?id=2011-040A-09); the Juno mission team page now names Ryan Park and Luciano Iess (https://www.missionjuno.swri.edu/the-team/) * Author: Listed as Gravity Science Principal Investigator in the NSSDC Master Catalog (https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/nmc/experiment/display.action?id=2011-040A-09); also an author of the Juno Gravity Science instrument description paper (Asmar et al. 2017, https://doi.org/10.1007/s11214-017-0428-7)

* InstrumentLead: Named Gravity lead, with Ryan Park, on the Juno mission team page (https://www.missionjuno.swri.edu/the-team/); INAF Media names him principal investigator of the Ka-band translator (KaT) (https://www.media.inaf.it/2012/11/08/laquila-per-giove/) * Author: Named Gravity (X- and Ka-band) lead, with Ryan Park, on the Juno mission team page (https://www.missionjuno.swri.edu/the-team/)

* InstrumentLead: Named Gravity lead, with Luciano Iess, on the Juno mission team page (https://www.missionjuno.swri.edu/the-team/) * Author: Named Gravity (X- and Ka-band) lead, with Luciano Iess, on the Juno mission team page (https://www.missionjuno.swri.edu/the-team/)
